summary: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional with 5+ years building data lakehouse and cloud data warehouse pipelines using SQL, Python, Apache Spark, Snowflake, dbt, and Airflow on AWS and Azure, including 2 years at Comcast delivering multi-terabyte daily pipelines with built-in data quality, observability, and lineage.

Cloud & DevOps: AWS (S3, Lambda, Glue, SQS, Redshift, IAM)

highlights: Migrated a legacy claims data pipeline built on SQL Server stored procedures and SSIS packages to Databricks, rewriting T-SQL logic in PySpark and Spark SQL and cutting end-to-end processing time 50%.

Validated the migration with automated row-count, checksum, and column-level reconciliation between legacy and Databricks outputs, achieving 100% data parity across 3M+ daily claim records before cutover.
Converted full nightly reloads into incremental Delta Lake MERGE and Auto Loader patterns, reducing compute cost per run 35% while keeping claims data fresh for reporting and analytics.
Engineered a PySpark ingestion framework that flattens nested JSON and XML estimate files and unpacks zipped claim archives, standardizing 12+ semi-structured feeds into curated Delta tables.
Prepared model-ready multimodal datasets linking 500K+ claim photos, estimate PDFs, and repair notes to claim metadata, cutting data preparation time 60% for the computer vision team.
Governed 80+ migrated tables in Unity Catalog with data lineage, PII masking, and role-based access, orchestrating them through Databricks Lakeflow Jobs with data quality checks and failure alerts.

Architected a Databricks and AWS data lakehouse processing 10+ TB of daily cybersecurity telemetry from firewalls, endpoints, and threat-detection systems, standardizing raw logs into Unity Catalog governed Delta tables using medallion design patterns.

Unified logs from 50+ security tools into a Snowflake cloud data warehouse, building ingestion frameworks with Cribl, Apache Airflow, and AWS Lambda (JSON → S3 → Snowpipe) and dbt staging, intermediate, and marts layers that cut analyst query time 45%.

Reduced data processing latency 30%+ by orchestrating Airflow DAGs and Databricks Lakeflow Jobs across 10+ interdependent pipelines running up to 5 concurrent executions with zero dependency failures.

Established data observability across every layer with dbt tests, source-freshness checks, and a SparkQueryListener and Kafka monitor tracking streaming job health, reducing data quality incidents 40% and reporting SLA status to stakeholders.

Cut nightly table maintenance runtime 65% by migrating 40+ Delta tables from partitioning and Z-ORDER to liquid clustering, enabling predictive optimization, and turning on deletion vectors for CDC MERGE targets to eliminate full file rewrites.

Lowered Snowflake compute costs 20% and storage costs $5,000/year through warehouse right-sizing, auto-suspend, clustering keys, and result-cache reuse, using query history to isolate the 5% of queries driving most spend.

Delivered data consumption layers of secure database views, REST APIs, and scheduled data extracts for SOC analysts, applying RBAC and dynamic masking by data sensitivity, and routed enriched threat data back into Splunk via AWS SQS, reducing SIEM noise 35%.

Automated releases with Terraform modules and GitHub Actions CI/CD provisioning Databricks jobs, clusters, Snowflake roles, and permissions across dev, staging, and production with zero manual intervention.
Engineered large-scale ETL pipelines in Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory ingesting multi-source data into an ADLS Gen2 data lake, improving data consistency and refresh accuracy 40%+.

Built a metadata-driven ingestion framework and reusable Python REST API connector (retry logic, pagination) adopted organization-wide, cutting new data source integration time 50% and onboarding effort 40%.
Re-platformed legacy T-SQL stored procedures into modular PySpark and layered SQL models, reducing daily batch runtime by 30+ minutes and improving performance 15%.

Resolved severe data skew in billion-row joins by diagnosing straggler tasks in the Spark UI (max duration 10x the median), salting hot keys, and handling null join keys explicitly, reducing affected stage runtime 40%.
Eliminated disk spill by tuning shuffle partitions per workload to 100-200 MB each and co-partitioning data on join keys to remove redundant shuffles, cutting job runtime 30%.
Replaced Python UDFs with native Spark SQL functions and Arrow-backed Pandas UDFs, and moved filters ahead of UDF execution, improving affected stage runtimes 60-70%.

Designed star and snowflake schema marts in Azure Synapse with documented transformation rules, data lineage, and schema-drift checks, enabling self-service Power BI reporting and faster change management for cross-functional teams.
Authored and optimized complex SQL for BI reports used by product teams, improving report accuracy and cutting data-request turnaround 35%.
Automated recurring data cleaning and preprocessing workflows with Python scripts, saving 10+ hours of manual effort per week.

projects.title: Clickstream and Transaction Analytics Platform (Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Looker)
highlights: Architected an ELT platform loading 5M+ daily clickstream JSON events and transactional records into Snowflake via Snowpipe, orchestrated by metadata-driven Airflow DAGs with SLA alerts to Slack.

Modeled staging, intermediate, and marts layers in dbt with tests, docs, and lineage graphs to build a 360-degree customer view, and exposed curated marts through secure views and an embedded Looker dashboard.
Automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions and dbt Cloud, running validation and dry-runs on every pull request to block breaking changes before deployment.

projects.title: Local RAG Pipeline: Healthcare Data Q&A (LangChain, Ollama, ChromaDB)
highlights: Built an offline RAG pipeline with LangChain and Gemma 4 (12B) via Ollama, enabling privacy-preserving natural-language Q&A over structured healthcare data with zero external API dependencies.

Transformed PySpark-produced Parquet records into semantically rich text summaries and embedded them with nomic-embed-text into a persistent ChromaDB vector store supporting batch ingestion of multi-part datasets.
Grounded model responses in retrieved patient records through a conversational retrieval interface, reducing hallucinations and anchoring every answer to source data.

projects.title: Hybrid Healthcare Data Engineering Pipeline (FHIR → Medallion → RBAC)
highlights: Engineered a Bronze → Silver → Gold pipeline ingesting synthetic FHIR R4 bundles with PySpark, building dedicated Silver tables for Claims, Patients, Encounters, and Conditions.
Combined batch (PySpark) and real-time streaming (Python Kafka Producer → Kafka on Docker → Structured Streaming) to simulate concurrent hospital feeds across 50 partitioned data folders.

Modeled the Gold layer as Kimball-compliant dbt star-schema marts (2 fact, 9 dimension tables) with deterministic MD5 surrogate keys and dbt tests (not null, unique, relationships) enforcing referential integrity across complex FHIR reference patterns.

Implemented HIPAA-aligned governance with PHI hashing and generalization — RBAC, column-level security, and dynamic masking enforcing field-level PHI restrictions across Admin and Clinical Analyst roles in a PostgreSQL serving layer, queryable via DuckDB.

projects.title: Security Log Analytics and Threat Detection Platform (Azure)
highlights: Built an end-to-end security-telemetry analytics platform on ADF and Databricks, processing firewall, endpoint, and network logs from ADLS Gen2 into SIEM-ready datasets via a Bronze → Silver → Gold medallion architecture.
Automated infrastructure and scheduling with Terraform, Azure DevOps, and Apache Airflow for version-controlled, SLA-compliant, fully auditable production runs.

Developed PySpark transformations to clean, enrich, and structure raw JSON security events into Parquet/Delta datasets, with schema validation and data-quality checks that flag failed loads pre-consumption.
Delivered Power BI (Microsoft Power Platform) and Synapse dashboards surfacing real-time threat anomalies, top attack sources, and detection metrics for cybersecurity teams.

projects.title: Real-Time Market Event Simulator
highlights: Developed a real-time market event simulation system using Apache Kafka, processing high-frequency financial data streams with producer-consumer architecture to simulate realistic market conditions.

Engineered multi-threaded event generation pipeline in Python that produces configurable market events (trades, orders, price updates) with customizable frequencies and batch sizes for performance testing.
Implemented robust data streaming infrastructure with Kafka topic management, consumer group handling, and offset tracking to ensure reliable message delivery and fault tolerance.
Built monitoring and analytics capabilities including real-time event consumption tracking, latency measurement, and throughput analysis to evaluate system performance under various load conditions.

Designed flexible configuration system supporting multiple market scenarios (normal, volatile, crash conditions) with parameterized event generation for testing different market behaviors and stress scenarios.

projects.title: Databricks Spark Query Listener – Streaming Job Monitoring Framework
highlights: Developed a Spark Query Listener based framework to capture job metrics, performance stats, and error events across structured streaming and batch pipelines in Databricks.
Integrated Kafka to stream Spark listener events into a centralized monitoring layer, enabling real time analysis and alerting.
Implemented a PySpark streaming pipeline to persist monitoring data in Delta tables managed by Unity Catalog for time series performance tracking.
Deployed infrastructure using Terraform and automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions, ensuring consistent provisioning across environments.

projects.title: Retail Analytics Platform (AWS)
highlights: Designed and implemented an automated ETL pipeline using AWS S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift to process 50K+ retail events/hour.
Built data ingestion and transformation workflows using Python and PySpark, handling structured and semi-structured datasets at scale.
Optimized SQL queries and partition strategies, reducing dashboard refresh latency and improving query performance by 30%.
Developed interactive dashboards in Power BI to track inventory trends, improving demand forecasting accuracy by 25%.

Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Communication Engineering
